All existing factual values, other rule statuses, field gaps and original adaptation JSON remain unchanged. Only BUDDY_TV_TAG gains a separately authored Tag Team review at medium confidence. Source extraction may be cached; no primary hardware, installed patch or prototype gameplay is certified.
